tasks.title: PLAN: docs/DESKTOP_APPS.md — desktop target architecture (ADR): reuse nord-player/wry shell vs native egui apps; capability model, API surface per tier (JS via IPC bridge, Rust direct); permissions/sandbox; what real apps need (checklist)
nord-desktop crate: shared Rust backend services behind one trait set (fs, dialogs, notifications, clipboard, shell/open, paths, app lifecycle) used by JS bridge and Rust apps

Files & folders: scoped fs API (read/write/list/watch/stat/mkdir/remove/rename), per-app allowed roots (app data, documents, user-picked via dialog), path traversal protection, macOS sandbox/security-scoped bookmarks
Native dialogs: open/save file, pick folder, message/confirm, with remembered recent locations (rfd)
System notifications (local), badges, dock/taskbar progress; macOS/Windows/Linux backends
Persistent app storage: key-value + structured (sqlite or sled), settings file, app data dir, migrations; secure secrets via OS keychain
Clipboard (text/image/files), drag & drop in/out, open-with / file associations / custom URL scheme (deep links), single-instance + argv handling
Windows & menus: multi-window, native menu bar + context menus, global shortcuts, tray/menu-bar icon, always-on-top/frameless/transparent, fullscreen, window state persistence

Background work: threads/async tasks API, timers, process spawn (sandboxed allow-list), HTTP client with permission prompt, optional local server; app lifecycle (suspend, quit confirm, autostart/login item)
JS bridge: window.nord.desktop.* (fs, dialogs, notify, clipboard, store, window, menu, tray) over wry IPC with capability checks; typed d.ts + docs; same API in dev (editor Play) and exported apps
Rust desktop API in nord-app-wasm/nord-runtime: native path = direct crates, web path = graceful fallbacks (File System Access API, Notifications API, localStorage/IndexedDB); one cfg-free app API
Permissions/capabilities manifest in nord.project.json (desktop.permissions) + first-run prompts + editor UI to review; least-privilege defaults; audit log
Packaging: macOS .app/.dmg (sign + notarise docs), Windows installer/portable exe, Linux AppImage/deb; icons, version metadata, auto-update strategy (optional, opt-in)
Accessibility & real-app UX: IME/text input, high-DPI, dark mode follow, keyboard navigation, undo/redo helpers, i18n (locale/formatting), drag-reorder lists, virtualised tables

Templates + examples: desktop notes app (files+store+notifications), file organiser (fs+dialogs), clipboard manager (tray+global shortcut), markdown editor — JS and Rust variants; e2e where headless-possible
Tests & CI: capability unit tests, fs sandbox escape tests, per-OS CI matrix (macos-14, windows, ubuntu) building/launching sample apps headless; document unverified parts honestly
